job.job_description:
We're hiring an AI Engineer Agentic AI & Knowledge Graphs for one of India's leading conglomerate.




Location: Mumbai (Fort)
Experience: 5-10 Years

Education (Mandatory): B.Tech / B.E from IITs only
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent with MNC




Job Summary

We are looking for passionate AI Engineers with hands-on experience in building production-grade Agentic AI and GenAI applications. In this role, you will design and develop reusable AI solutions powered by LLMs, multi-agent systems, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs that can be adopted across multiple business units.

Key Responsibilities

Build production-grade Agentic AI & GenAI applications.
Design and implement multi-agent workflows using LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI.
Develop Knowledge Graphs and GraphRAG solutions using Neo4j.
Build RAG applications integrated with Vector Databases.
Develop scalable Python APIs & microservices using FastAPI.
Deploy and maintain AI solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Cloud.



Required Qualifications

B.Tech / B.E should be from IITs only
5-10 years of experience developing and deploying AI/ML applications.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
Strong understanding of Agentic AI, tool calling, memory, and orchestration.
Experience with Knowledge Graphs, Neo4j, GraphRAG, ontology modeling, and entity resolution.
Hands-on experience building RAG applications and working with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector).
Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
